# Step 8：基因甲基化汇总

只汇总本组学 DMR。每个基因、功能层保留绝对甲基化差异最大的区域，同时保留其他区域的数目和方向冲突；这些是描述性汇总，不是基因级独立检验。

```{r gene_methylation_summary}
ensure_dmr_outputs_loaded()
ensure_dmr_cgi_context(required = FALSE, persist = TRUE)
ensure_step_dirs("result/8_gene_methylation/tables/1", "result/8_gene_methylation/plots/1")
gene_methylation_long <- build_gene_methylation_summary(dmr_anno_df)
write_csv(gene_methylation_long, "result/8_gene_methylation/tables/1/gene_methylation_long.csv")
gene_methylation_wide <- gene_methylation_long %>%
  select(gene_id_clean, SYMBOL, Layer, diffMethy, DMR_id, RegionCount, DirectionConflict) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Layer, values_from = c(diffMethy, DMR_id, RegionCount, DirectionConflict))
write_csv(gene_methylation_wide, "result/8_gene_methylation/tables/1/gene_methylation_wide.csv")
if(nrow(gene_methylation_long) > 0) {
  p <- ggplot(gene_methylation_long, aes(x = Layer, y = diffMethy)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_wgbs_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = "基因关联 DMR 的甲基化差异", x = "功能层", y = group_diff_axis_label)
  ggsave("result/8_gene_methylation/plots/1/gene_methylation_layers.pdf", p, width = 8, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)
}
```
